title: When should an anomaly change an explanation?
evidence_type: Reviewed general reading path — English editorial slice
question: A prediction fails. Should we question the observation, revise the model, or change the research programme?

answers.author: Karl Popper
answers.answer: A claim must risk an observable failure. Accepting a falsification also requires a testable refuting effect; a stray contradictory observation alone does not settle the case.
answers.source_title: The Logic of Scientific Discovery, chapter 4, sections 19–22
answers.locator: Chapter 4, especially section 22; excerpt printed pages 57–66
answers.source_nature: University-hosted chapter excerpt; underlying excerpt edition not established

answers.author: Imre Lakatos
answers.answer: Evaluate the sequence of revisions: does it lead to new predictions that later receive support, or only accommodate facts already known? A young programme may need time; that is not unlimited protection.
answers.locator: Four-page transcript, pages 2–4; editorial bracketed additions distinguished
answers.source_nature: University-hosted transcript of the 1973 Open University talk
answers.anonymous_check: Opened without authenticated repository access on 2026-10-07

answers.author: Thomas S. Kuhn
answers.answer: Researchers can share values such as accuracy and scope while applying and weighting them differently. The absence of a compulsory choice algorithm does not make every choice equally defensible.
answers.source_title: Objectivity, Value Judgment, and Theory Choice
answers.locator: Collection chapter 13; existing collection read checked anthology pages 357–358 and 362–363
answers.source_nature: Publisher catalogue verifies chapter identity; the catalogue is not the essay text
answers.anonymous_check: Publisher catalogue opened on 2026-10-07; this round did not reverify the course scan text

disagreement: These are different units and purposes of evaluation: a testable refutation, the progress of a programme, and reasoned choices within a community. The reading path does not fuse them into one verdict procedure.
